slides.title: Welcome to Food & Nutrition
slides.content:
# Food and Nutrition - Fuel for Your Body!

Just like a car needs fuel to run, your body needs **food** to work properly!

## What You Will Learn:
- The **basic food groups** and what each one does
- **Healthy eating habits** for a strong body
- Why a **balanced diet** is important
- Where our **food comes from**

## Why Is Food Important?
- Food gives you **energy** to play, study, and grow
- Food helps **repair** your body when it is hurt
- Food keeps you **healthy** and protects you from illness
- Food helps your **brain** think and learn

## Fun Food Facts:
- You will eat about **35 tons** of food in your lifetime!
- Your stomach can hold about **1 liter** of food
- It takes about **6-8 hours** to fully digest a meal
- Chewing your food well helps your body absorb nutrients better

> **Think About It:** What did you eat today? Was it healthy? Let's learn how to choose the best foods for your body!

slides.title: Basic Food Groups - Energy Foods
slides.content:
# The Basic Food Groups

Food can be divided into groups based on what they do for your body.

## Group 1: Energy-Giving Foods (Carbohydrates)

These foods give you the **energy** you need to run, play, think, and do everyday activities.

### Sources of Carbohydrates:
- **Grains:** Rice, wheat, corn, oats, bread
- **Starchy foods:** Potatoes, sweet potatoes, yams
- **Sugary foods:** Sugar, honey, jaggery, fruits

### Why You Need Energy Foods:
- They give your body **fuel** to function
- Your brain uses a lot of energy to **think and learn**
- Your muscles need energy to **move**
- They keep you **active** throughout the day

## Group 2: Energy-Giving Foods (Fats)

Fats also give energy, but in a more **concentrated** form.

### Sources of Fats:
- **Oils:** Coconut oil, olive oil, sunflower oil
- **Butter and ghee**
- **Nuts:** Almonds, cashews, peanuts, walnuts
- **Seeds:** Sunflower seeds, flax seeds

### What Fats Do:
- Give **long-lasting energy**
- Keep your body **warm**
- Protect your organs
- Help absorb some **vitamins**

> **Balance is key:** You need energy foods, but eating TOO much can make you gain unhealthy weight. Eat the right amount!

slides.title: Body-Building Foods
slides.content:
# Group 3: Body-Building Foods (Proteins)

Proteins help your body **grow** and **repair** itself. They are the building blocks of your body!

### Sources of Protein:

**From Animals:**
- Eggs
- Milk, cheese, yogurt
- Chicken and fish
- Meat

**From Plants:**
- Lentils (dal) and beans
- Peas and chickpeas
- Soybeans and tofu
- Nuts like almonds and peanuts

### Why You Need Proteins:
- Help you **grow taller and stronger**
- **Repair** wounds and injuries
- Build **muscles** and bones
- Make **hair and nails** grow
- Help your body **fight diseases**

### How Much Protein Do You Need?
- Children need protein for rapid **growth**
- You should eat protein-rich food at **every meal**
- Mix both animal and plant proteins for best nutrition

### Protein Fun Facts:
| Food | Protein Content |
|------|-----------------|
| 1 egg | About 6 grams |
| 1 glass of milk | About 8 grams |
| 1 cup of dal | About 18 grams |
| Handful of peanuts | About 7 grams |

> **Did You Know:** Your hair and nails are made of a protein called **keratin**! That is why eating protein helps them grow.

slides.title: Protective Foods - Vitamins
slides.content:
# Group 4: Protective Foods (Vitamins and Minerals)

Vitamins and minerals protect your body from **diseases** and keep everything working properly.

## Important Vitamins:

### Vitamin A (For Eyes)
- Keeps your **eyes healthy** and helps you see in dim light
- Found in: Carrots, mangoes, papaya, spinach, sweet potatoes

### Vitamin B (For Energy)
- Helps your body **use energy** from food
- Found in: Whole grains, eggs, meat, milk, bananas

### Vitamin C (For Immunity)
- Helps your body **fight diseases** and heals wounds faster
- Found in: Oranges, lemons, guava, amla (Indian gooseberry), tomatoes

### Vitamin D (For Bones)
- Makes your **bones and teeth strong**
- Found in: Sunlight (!), milk, eggs, fish
- Your body makes Vitamin D when you play in the **sun**!

## Important Minerals:

### Calcium
- Makes **bones and teeth** strong
- Found in: Milk, cheese, yogurt, green leafy vegetables

### Iron
- Helps blood carry **oxygen** to all body parts
- Found in: Spinach, jaggery, dates, beans, red meat

### Iodine
- Keeps your **thyroid gland** healthy
- Found in: Iodized salt, seafood, dairy products

> **Colorful Rule:** Eat a **rainbow of fruits and vegetables** every day. Different colors have different vitamins!

slides.title: Water and Fiber
slides.content:
# Two More Essential Things: Water and Fiber

## Water - The Most Important Drink!

Water is NOT food, but it is **essential for life**.

### Why You Need Water:
- Makes up about **70% of your body**
- Helps in **digestion** of food
- Carries **nutrients** to all body parts
- Removes **waste** from your body
- Keeps your body **cool** (through sweating)
- Keeps your skin **healthy**

### How Much Water Should You Drink?
- Children should drink about **6-8 glasses** of water daily
- Drink **more** when it is hot or when you play sports
- Do not wait until you are thirsty - drink regularly!

### Signs You Need More Water:
- Feeling **thirsty**
- Dark yellow **urine**
- Feeling **tired** or having a headache
- Dry **lips and mouth**

## Fiber - Nature's Cleaner

### What Fiber Does:
- Helps food move through your **digestive system**
- Prevents **constipation**
- Keeps your stomach **healthy**

### Sources of Fiber:
- Whole grains (brown rice, whole wheat bread)
- Fruits (apples, pears, oranges)
- Vegetables (broccoli, carrots, beans)
- Nuts and seeds

> **Tip:** Start your day with a glass of water. It wakes up your body and gets your digestion going!

slides.title: The Balanced Diet
slides.content:
# The Balanced Diet - Eating Right!

A **balanced diet** means eating the right amounts of ALL food groups every day.

## What Does a Balanced Meal Look Like?

Imagine your plate divided into sections:

### The Ideal Plate:
- **Half the plate:** Fruits and Vegetables
- **Quarter of the plate:** Grains (rice, bread, roti)
- **Quarter of the plate:** Protein (dal, eggs, fish, chicken)
- **A small portion:** Healthy fats (nuts, oil)
- **A glass of:** Milk or water

## A Balanced Day of Eating:

### Breakfast (Most Important Meal!)
- Whole wheat bread or oats with milk
- A fruit (banana, apple)
- An egg or a glass of milk

### Lunch
- Rice or roti
- Dal (lentils) or vegetables
- Salad and yogurt

### Snacks
- Fruits, nuts, or sprouts
- Avoid chips and candy!

### Dinner
- Lighter than lunch
- Roti with vegetables
- A glass of milk

## Why Balance Matters:

| Too Much Of | Can Cause |
|------------|----------|
| Sugar | Tooth decay, weight gain |
| Fat | Obesity, heart problems |
| Salt | High blood pressure |
| Junk food | Poor nutrition, tiredness |

> **Rule of Thumb:** The more **colorful** your plate, the more **nutritious** your meal!

slides.title: Healthy Eating Habits
slides.content:
# Healthy Eating Habits

It is not just WHAT you eat but also HOW you eat that matters!

## Good Eating Habits:

### 1. Eat at Regular Times
- Have meals at the **same time** every day
- Do not skip **breakfast** - it is the most important meal!
- Eat dinner at least **2 hours before bedtime**

### 2. Chew Your Food Well
- Chew each bite **at least 20-30 times**
- Chewing breaks food into smaller pieces
- This makes digestion **easier**
- It also helps you **enjoy** the taste more

### 3. Do Not Overeat
- Eat only until you feel **comfortably full**
- Stop eating when your stomach says "enough"
- Overeating causes **stomach pain** and weight gain

### 4. Eat Slowly
- Do not rush your meals
- Put your spoon down between bites
- It takes about **20 minutes** for your brain to know you are full

### 5. Wash Hands Before Eating
- Always wash hands with **soap and water**
- This removes **germs** that can make you sick

### 6. Eat Together
- Eating with family is a great habit
- It makes meals more **enjoyable**
- You tend to eat **healthier** when eating with family

> **Bad Habit Alert:** Do not watch TV or play on a phone while eating. It makes you eat too much without realizing it!

slides.title: Junk Food vs Healthy Food
slides.content:
# Junk Food vs Healthy Food

## What Is Junk Food?

**Junk food** is food that tastes good but has very **little nutrition**. It is high in sugar, salt, and fat.

### Examples of Junk Food:
- Chips and fries
- Candy and chocolate bars
- Soda and sugary drinks
- Burgers and pizza (when eaten too often)
- Ice cream and cakes
- Instant noodles

### Why Junk Food Is Bad:
- Has too much **sugar** (causes tooth decay)
- Has too much **salt** (bad for your heart)
- Has too much **fat** (causes weight gain)
- Has very few **vitamins and minerals**
- Makes you feel **tired** and lazy

## Healthy Alternatives:

| Instead of... | Try... |
|--------------|--------|
| Chips | Roasted nuts or popcorn |
| Candy | Fresh fruits |
| Soda | Fresh juice or coconut water |
| Ice cream | Yogurt with fruits |
| Cookies | Whole grain crackers |

## The 80-20 Rule:
- Eat **healthy food 80%** of the time
- It is okay to have a small treat **20%** of the time
- This way you stay healthy but do not feel deprived!

> **Smart Choice:** When you feel like snacking, grab a fruit or a handful of nuts. Your body will thank you!

slides.title: Food Sources
slides.content:
# Where Does Our Food Come From?

All our food ultimately comes from **plants** or **animals**.

## Food from Plants:

### Different Parts We Eat:
| Plant Part | Examples |
|-----------|----------|
| Roots | Carrots, radish, beetroot, turnip |
| Stems | Sugarcane, potato, ginger |
| Leaves | Spinach, cabbage, lettuce, mint |
| Flowers | Cauliflower, broccoli |
| Fruits | Mango, apple, tomato, cucumber |
| Seeds | Rice, wheat, peas, beans, nuts |

## Food from Animals:

| Animal | Food We Get |
|--------|------------|
| Cow | Milk, butter, cheese, ghee |
| Hen | Eggs |
| Fish | Fish meat |
| Bee | Honey |
| Goat | Milk, meat |
| Buffalo | Milk |

## How Food Reaches Your Plate:

1. **Farmers** grow crops or raise animals
2. Food is **harvested** or collected
3. It goes to **factories** for processing and packaging
4. **Trucks** transport food to shops and markets
5. Your family **buys** it from the store
6. It is **cooked** at home
7. It reaches your **plate**!

> **Thank a Farmer:** Every meal you eat was possible because of hard-working farmers. We should always be grateful for our food!

slides.title: Food Preservation
slides.content:
# Keeping Food Fresh: Food Preservation

Food can go **bad** if not stored properly. **Food preservation** is the process of keeping food safe to eat for longer.

## Why Does Food Go Bad?
- Tiny organisms called **germs** (bacteria and fungi) grow on food
- They make food **smell bad, look moldy, and taste terrible**
- Eating spoiled food can make you very **sick**

## Methods to Keep Food Fresh:

### 1. Refrigeration
- Keeping food **cold** slows down germs
- Milk, fruits, vegetables, and cooked food should be refrigerated

### 2. Drying
- Removing **water** from food stops germs from growing
- Examples: Dried fruits, dried fish, spices

### 3. Pickling
- Adding **salt, oil, or vinegar** preserves food
- Examples: Pickles, jams, marmalades

### 4. Freezing
- Very cold temperatures **stop** germs completely
- Examples: Frozen vegetables, ice cream, frozen meat

### 5. Canning
- Food is sealed in airtight **cans or jars**
- Examples: Canned beans, canned fruit, canned fish

## Food Safety Rules:
- Always check the **expiry date** on packaged food
- **Wash** fruits and vegetables before eating
- **Cover** food to keep flies and dust away
- Do not eat food that **smells bad or looks moldy**
- **Reheat** leftover food properly before eating

> **Never eat:** Food that has been left out for too long, especially in hot weather. When in doubt, throw it out!

slides.title: Deficiency Diseases
slides.content:
# What Happens When You Do Not Eat Right?

When your body does not get enough of a certain nutrient, you can develop a **deficiency disease**.

## Common Deficiency Problems:

### Not Enough Vitamin A:
- Causes **poor vision** especially at night
- Called **Night Blindness**
- Eat more: Carrots, mangoes, papaya

### Not Enough Vitamin C:
- Causes **scurvy** (bleeding gums, weak immunity)
- Eat more: Oranges, lemons, amla, guava

### Not Enough Vitamin D:
- Causes **rickets** (weak, soft bones)
- Get more: Sunlight, milk, eggs

### Not Enough Calcium:
- Causes **weak bones and teeth**
- Eat more: Milk, cheese, yogurt, green vegetables

### Not Enough Iron:
- Causes **anemia** (feeling tired, pale skin)
- Eat more: Spinach, jaggery, dates, beans

### Not Enough Protein:
- Causes **poor growth** and weak muscles
- Eat more: Eggs, dal, milk, fish

## Prevention Is Easy:

| Eat This | To Prevent |
|----------|------------|
| Colorful fruits and vegetables | Vitamin deficiency |
| Milk and dairy | Weak bones |
| Green leafy vegetables | Anemia |
| Eggs, dal, fish | Poor growth |
| Play in sunlight | Weak bones |

> **Simple Rule:** If you eat a variety of foods from ALL food groups every day, you will get all the nutrients you need!

slides.title: Food and Culture
slides.content:
# Food Around the World

Different people around the world eat different types of food based on their **culture**, **climate**, and what grows in their region.

## Food in Different Parts of India:

| Region | Popular Foods |
|--------|---------------|
| North India | Roti, dal, paneer, lassi |
| South India | Rice, dosa, idli, sambar |
| East India | Fish, rice, sweets like rasgulla |
| West India | Dhokla, thepla, vada pav |

## Food Around the World:

| Country | Famous Food |
|---------|------------|
| Italy | Pizza, pasta, gelato |
| Japan | Sushi, ramen, rice |
| Mexico | Tacos, burritos, guacamole |
| China | Noodles, dumplings, rice |
| USA | Burgers, pancakes, apple pie |

## Special Foods for Special Occasions:
- **Birthday:** Cake
- **Festivals:** Sweets and special dishes
- **Winter:** Hot soups and warm foods
- **Summer:** Cold drinks, ice cream, watermelon

## Respecting Food:
- **Never waste food** - millions of people do not have enough to eat
- Take only what you can **finish**
- Share food with those who are **hungry**
- Be grateful for every meal

> **Food connects us!** Sharing food with others is one of the best ways to show love and friendship.

slides.title: Summary and Key Points
slides.content:
# Summary: Food and Nutrition

## The Food Groups:

| Group | What They Do | Examples |
|-------|-------------|----------|
| Carbohydrates | Give energy | Rice, bread, potatoes |
| Proteins | Build and repair body | Eggs, dal, milk, fish |
| Fats | Give energy, keep warm | Nuts, oil, butter |
| Vitamins | Protect from disease | Fruits, vegetables |
| Minerals | Keep organs working | Milk, spinach, salt |
| Water | Essential for all functions | Water, juices |
| Fiber | Helps digestion | Whole grains, fruits |

## Key Healthy Eating Rules:
1. Eat a **balanced diet** with all food groups
2. Eat plenty of **fruits and vegetables**
3. Drink **6-8 glasses of water** daily
4. Do not skip **breakfast**
5. Limit **junk food and sugary drinks**
6. Chew food **properly**
7. Wash hands **before eating**
8. Never **waste food**

## Remember:
- Food comes from **plants and animals**
- A **balanced plate** is half fruits/vegetables, quarter grains, quarter protein
- Missing nutrients cause **deficiency diseases**
- Different cultures have different **food traditions**

> **Congratulations!** You are now a nutrition expert. Use this knowledge to make healthy food choices every day!
